english.title: Transport animals in Wales in way that causes injury/suffering

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Welfare of Animals Transport Wales Order 2007

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without lawful authority or excuse, transported a cold-blooded invertebrate animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), in a way which caused, or was likely to cause, injury or unnecessary suffering to that animal
english.legislation: Contrary to article 4(1) of the Welfare of Animals (Transport) (Wales) Order 2007, sections 73 and 75 of the Animal Health Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
without lawful authority or excuse
transported an animal
in a way which caused, or was likely to cause, injury or unnecessary suffering to that animal

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant without lawful authority or excuse, transported a cold-blooded invertebrate animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), in a way which caused, or was likely to cause, injury or unnecessary suffering to that animal.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and/or a level 5 fineTime limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
